newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Strong earthquake recorded over Philippines - HK.
newsitem.headline: Strong earthquake recorded over Philippines - HK.

text.p: A strong earthquake estimated at 5.5 on the Richter scale was recorded in the Philippines late on Wednesday, the Hong Kong Royal Observatory said on Thursday.
The epicentre of the quake, detected at 2355 local time (1555 GMT) on Wednesday, was initially placed in Mindoro in the Philippines, about 200 km (125 miles) south-southeast of Manila.
No information on casualties was immediately available.
